disclaimer.short: Map yi yɛ mfomsoɔ nko ara. Ɛtumi sesa — daadaa fa wo ho adwene na wo dwo.
disclaimer.long: SignPost yɛ oman a ɔsɔ so nnwuma map. Awufoɔ no ntua hɔ ma nsɛmfua, ahotɔ, anaa nnwuma a wɔakyerɛ no ho nkodaa biara. Saa platform yi ayɛ na mmara a ɛmfata ho asɛm yɛ yiye. Map yi fa ho de kyerɛ sɛ wogree saa akwan yi. Sɛ wuhu nsɛm a ɛnnyɛ anaa ɛbɔ haw a, fa dawuro to ho. Awufoɔ ades:

about.title: Fa SignPost Ho
about.body:
SignPost yɛ free oman a ɔsɔ so map a ɛboa nnipa wɔ Greater Seattle Nhyiamu mu sɛ wɔahu nnwuma te sɛ aduane banks, efie, nsuo a wonnom, tiafi, fon charge, ne ɔhaw to so dwumadie.

Obiara tumi fa beae bom anaa dane no. Oman nsɛm tumi kyɛ afotu, bɔ dawuru wɔ nnsakrae ho, ne hwɛ sɛ nsɛmfua no da hɔ daadaa.

Kae pin wɔ map so na wahunu nsɛm ne kwan.

SignPost ankɔta ho nsɛm biara. Account biara nhia.
about.helpAddTitle: Fa nnwuma bom ne dane no
about.helpAddData: Wunim nnwuma a ɛnni map so? Kae + Fa Bom na wode kɔ. Map no dane yɛ kwan tɔnso na woboa.
about.helpPoster: Prin poster na fa si wo oman mu — laundry, efie, nhoma dan, oman habitation. Obiara a ohunu tumi scan QR code anaa kyerɛw URL na ɔnya map no.
about.helpFeedbackDesc: Wowɔ adwene fa app no ho? Biribi a ɛnnye, a ɛsɛe anim, anaa a ɛkɔ? Wo adwene kɔ tɔnso kɔ awufoɔ nkyɛn.
about.feedbackSuccessDesc: Wo boaboa ma yɛtumi yɛ SignPost yiye.
about.feedbackUnavailable: Adwene de kɔ nnhia bea yi mu bio.
